# 2 bed cottage for sale

> Please note that this property is not suitable for purchasers obtaining mortgage funding. Kennedy Estate Agents offer this truly unique opportunity to purchase a detached, self-build project in an unbeatable location. The property is set on a scenic, shorefront, private site extending to approximately 1.4 acres.
